mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_governance.request_policy WHERE AND id=#{id}

SELECT FROM auth_governance.request_policy p WHERE AND enabled AND id > #{after} AND approver_membership_id <> #{member} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.membership m WHERE m.id=p.approver_membership_id AND m.generation=p.approver_generation AND m.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM auth_governance.access_request WHERE AND id=#{id} AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.access_request WHERE AND id=#{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM auth_governance.access_request WHERE AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation} AND state IN ('SUBMITTED','IN_REVIEW') AND valid_to > clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: WITH expired AS (SELECT o.request_id FROM auth_governance.request_start_outbox o JOIN auth_governance.access_request r ON r.id=o.request_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND o.state='RUNNING' AND o.attempts=5 AND o.lease_until < clock_timestamp() ORDER BY o.request_id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox o SET state='DEAD',last_error='OA_START_UNCONFIRMED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM expired e WHERE o.request_id=e.request_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.audit_event(id,operator_ref,tenant_id,operation,target_id,target_version,command_id) SELECT #{audit},'OA_START_WORKER',tenant_id,'OA_START_BOUND',id,state_version,#{lease} FROM auth_governance.access_request WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT o.request_id FROM auth_governance.request_start_outbox o JOIN auth_governance.access_request r ON r.id=o.request_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND r.state='SUBMITTED' AND r.valid_to > clock_timestamp() AND o.attempts < 5 AND o.next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (o.state='PENDING' OR (o.state='RUNNING' AND o.lease_until < clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY o.next_attempt_at,o.request_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox o SET state='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=#{lease}, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM candidate c WHERE o.request_id=c.request_id RETURNING o.request_id
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox SET state='DONE',lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts=5 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END, lease_until=NULL,last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>power(2,attempts)::int),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE auth_governance.access_request SET approval_instance_id=#{instance}, state=CASE WHEN state='SUBMITTED' THEN 'IN_REVIEW' ELSE state END,state_version=state_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND id=#{id} AND (approval_instance_id IS NULL OR approval_instance_id=#{instance})

UPDATE auth_governance.access_request SET state=#{state},grant_id=#{grant},state_version=state_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND id=#{id} AND state_version=#{version} AND state='IN_REVIEW'

UPDATE auth_governance.access_request SET state=#{state},state_version=state_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND id=#{id} AND state_version=#{version} AND state IN ('SUBMITTED','IN_REVIEW','APPROVED')
UPDATE auth_governance.request_start_outbox SET state='DONE',last_error=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_id=#{id} AND state='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM auth_governance.access_request r LEFT JOIN auth_governance.access_grant g ON g.id=r.grant_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND (r.state IN ('SUBMITTED','IN_REVIEW') OR (r.state='APPROVED' AND g.state IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE'))) AND (r.valid_to <=clock_timestamp() OR NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.id=r.membership_id AND m.generation=r.generation AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >clock_timestamp()))) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 100

SELECT r.id request_id,g.id grant_id,g.state grant_state, CASE WHEN r.state IN ('CANCELLED','REJECTED') AND g.id IS NULL THEN r.state WHEN g.id IS NULL THEN r.state WHEN g.state='REVOKED' THEN CASE WHEN p.state='READY' AND d.state='READY' AND rec.operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'REVOKED' ELSE 'REVOKING' END WHEN g.valid_to <=clock_timestamp() THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN m.status<>'ACTIVE' OR m.generation<>r.generation OR u.status<>'ACTIVE' OR t.status<>'ACTIVE' OR NOT a.enabled OR (m.valid_to IS NOT NULL AND m.valid_to <=clock_timestamp()) THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN p.state='BLOCKED' OR d.state='BLOCKED' THEN 'APPLY_FAILED' WHEN g.state='ACTIVE' AND g.zed_token IS NOT NULL AND rec.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND p.state='READY' AND p.desired_epoch=p.applied_epoch AND d.state='READY' AND d.desired_epoch=d.applied_epoch AND g.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'PENDING_APPLY' END display_state,rec.operation_id,o.state start_state,o.attempts start_attempts,o.last_error start_error, (SELECT i.status FROM auth_governance.approval_inbox i WHERE i.request_id=r.id AND i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.application_id=r.application_id AND i.environment=r.environment ORDER BY i.received_at DESC,i.event_id DESC LIMIT 1) callback_status, (SELECT i.result FROM auth_governance.approval_inbox i WHERE i.request_id=r.id AND i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.application_id=r.application_id AND i.environment=r.environment ORDER BY i.received_at DESC,i.event_id DESC LIMIT 1) callback_result, (SELECT count(*) FROM auth_governance.access_grant other WHERE other.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND other.application_id=r.application_id AND other.environment=r.environment AND other.membership_id=r.membership_id AND other.generation=r.generation AND other.id<>coalesce(g.id,'') AND other.state='ACTIVE' AND other.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND other.valid_to>clock_timestamp()) other_active_grant_count FROM auth_governance.access_request r JOIN auth_governance.request_start_outbox o ON o.request_id=r.id JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.id=r.membership_id JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=r.tenant_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant_application a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.application_id=r.application_id AND a.environment=r.environment LEFT JOIN auth_governance.access_grant g ON g.id=r.grant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.policy_partition p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.application_id=r.application_id AND p.environment=r.environment LEFT JOIN auth_governance.directory_fence d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_grant_receipt rec ON rec.grant_id=g.id AND rec.grant_version=g.version WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND r.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.access_request WHERE AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: WITH due AS (SELECT o.id FROM auth_governance.request_notice_outbox o JOIN auth_governance.access_request r ON r.id=o.request_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND o.state='RUNNING' AND o.attempts=5 AND o.lease_until < clock_timestamp() ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE auth_governance.request_notice_outbox o SET state='DEAD',lease_until=NULL FROM due WHERE o.id=due.id
mapper.select: WITH due AS (SELECT o.id FROM auth_governance.request_notice_outbox o JOIN auth_governance.access_request r ON r.id=o.request_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment} AND o.attempts < 5 AND o.next_attempt_at <=clock_timestamp() AND (o.state='PENDING' OR o.state='RUNNING' AND o.lease_until <clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY o.next_attempt_at,o.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE auth_governance.request_notice_outbox o SET state='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=#{lease},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds' FROM due WHERE o.id=due.id RETURNING o.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.request_site_notice(id,request_id,state_version,message_key) SELECT id,request_id,state_version,'REQUEST_PROGRESS_UPDATED' FROM auth_governance.request_notice_outbox WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp() ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.request_notice_outbox SET state='DONE',lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp()

UPDATE auth_governance.request_notice_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts=5 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END,lease_until=NULL, next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>power(2,attempts)::int) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp()
